reason: Shows generic jemalloc functions and module replies, entirely missing Redis Sets internal implementation (intset/dict).
Shows Lua sort functions and unrelated hash/list checks instead of skiplists or ziplists used for Sorted Sets.
Only shows an empty stream struct definition and unrelated tracking callbacks, missing the listpack/radix tree implementation details.
Mentions getExpire, keyIsExpired, and activeExpireCycleTryExpire which cover both passive and active TTL expiration logic.
Shows stream max size limits and maxmemory configuration updates, but completely misses the eviction execution logic.
Mentions evictionPoolAlloc and EvictionPoolLRU which are core to managing the pool for eviction policies.
Shows AOF truncation and unrelated string append commands, missing the core AOF writing/fsyncing mechanisms.
Lists rewriteAppendOnlyFile in aof.c which is the core function responsible for the background AOF rewrite.
Shows a Python CLI script and unrelated buffer processing functions instead of the rdbSave or rdbSaveBackground logic.
Mentions backgroundSaveDoneHandler and backgroundSaveDoneHandlerDisk which handle the completion of the fork-based background save.
Mentions syncCommand in replication.c which is the core function handling the initial sync from a replica.
Shows both slaveTryPartialResynchronization and masterTryPartialResynchronization which implement the PSYNC mechanism.
Only shows a Python script for generating command schemas and unrelated error handlers, missing replicationFeedSlaves.
Mentions sentinelMasterLooksSane which is directly relevant to how Sentinel monitors the state of master nodes.
Mentions sentinelAbortFailover and SENTINEL_FAILOVER_STATE enums which are part of the Sentinel failover state machine.
Shows cluster initialization but fails to explain key distribution, slot hashing (CRC16), or slot mapping.
Mentions clusterBroadcastMessage and clusterSendPing which are the core functions for the cluster gossip protocol.
Only shows the clusterNode struct definition without explaining the failover process or node failure states.
Shows clusterRedirectClient which explicitly handles CLUSTER_REDIR_MOVED and CLUSTER_REDIR_ASK client redirects.
Only shows markdown and yaml files, without explaining the C API or how functions like RedisModule_CreateCommand extend Redis.
